title: Config-debt ratchet: the count of required inputs may never rise
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Pin the debt report's count in a baseline file (like the coverage ratchet); CI fails when a change adds a required input without lowering another. Tests zc_debt_ratchet_*.
